title: Angthong Marathon 2026 Review: What the Race Was Like
seo_title: Angthong Marathon Review: Course, Weather, Cut-offs, Results
meta_description: Angthong Marathon 2026 review: a 3am start from Sawan Park, a temple-lined loop through rice country, 27°C and 93% humidity before dawn, a tight 3:30 half cut-off and a small, older field.
dek: What the provincial marathon in Ang Thong was like on 4 October 2026: the route past the temples north of town, warm and heavy air before dawn, a tight half-marathon limit and a small field that leaves room to place.
verdict: Enter if you want a small, unhurried provincial marathon within reach of Bangkok, and you are happy to run most of it in the dark. The 2026 race started at 3am from Sawan Park and looped out past a string of temples to a turn near Wat Si Maha Pho, under a cloudy sky at about 27°C and 93% humidity. The field was small, 767 finishers across four races against a cap of 2,000, and mostly over 40, so age-group trophies are realistic. Watch the half-marathon limit: three and a half hours is tighter than most.

sections.heading: The Course: Temples, River and Rice Country
paragraphs: All four races start and finish at Sawan Park, the lakeside park at Nong Chet Sen in Ang Thong town [1][2]. The marathon map shows one big loop with an out-and-back arm. From the park, by the Luang Pu Thuat Buddhist park on Asian Highway 32, the route heads east past the provincial court, loops north past Wat Chantharangsi, Wat Klang, Wat Choeng Wai and Wat Dao Tueng, then runs west via Wat Ket and Wat Phai Thong to a U-turn near Wat Si Maha Pho at about 19 to 20 km, and returns the same way [3]. The map is an illustration rather than a surveyed plan, and draws the route through rice fields and along the river [3].

The half marathon is mostly out and back: east along the river past the provincial court to a U-turn at Asian Highway 32 at about 12 km, with a loop north past Wat Chantharangsi [4]. Its timed finish was set at 21.33 km [6].

sections.heading: The Weather: Warm, Heavy and Overcast
paragraphs: Open-Meteo's reanalysis for the grid point at Ang Thong shows about 27°C, a dew point of 26°C and 93% humidity at the 3am start, with an 8 km/h breeze and full cloud cover [5]. It hardly changed before dawn, at 26°C to 27°C until 7am, and no rain fell during the race. Then the cloud broke and it warmed: 29°C at 8am, 30°C at 9am and 32°C by the 10am marathon cut-off [5].
A 26°C dew point is oppressive: sweat barely evaporates. The cloud kept the sun off the marathon until well after the half and 10 km had finished, but anyone out past 8am ran into rising heat.

sections.heading: Cut-offs, Aid and the Half-Marathon Limit
paragraphs: The limits were seven hours for the marathon, three and a half hours for the half, two hours for the 10 km and one hour for the 5 km [2]. The half limit is tight for a mass race, but everyone who finished in 2026 made it: the slowest half marathoner ran 3:28:36, and one in ten took longer than three hours [6]. Two marathon finishers are listed just beyond seven hours [6].
The entry page does not say where the drinks stations were or how many there were [1]. Timing mats on the marathon sat at 1.75, 3.3, 11.7, 22 and 37.8 km [6].

sections.heading: How Fast the Field Is
paragraphs: Small and mostly middle-aged. The marathon had 99 finishers: it was won in 3:11:33, the first woman ran 3:50:49 and was tenth overall, and the median was 5:09:36. The slowest tenth took more than 6:38, 12% broke four hours, 43% broke five and 15% were women [6]. Seventy-eight of the 99 finishers were aged 40 to 59 [6].

The half marathon had 197 finishers, won in 1:28:15 and 1:49:42, with tenth place at 1:41:49 and a median of 2:14:15; 29% broke two hours and two-thirds broke 2:30 [6]. The 10 km had 280 finishers, a median of 1:10:37 and 28% under an hour [6].

About 923 runners entered against a cap of 2,000, and 767 finished [1][6]. Trophies went to the first man and woman overall and the top five in each age group in the marathon, half and 10 km, with no prize money [1]. With fields this thin, a steady runner over 50 has a real chance of a trophy.

sections.heading: Race Weekend Logistics
paragraphs: Race kits were collected on Saturday 3 October, 10am to 7pm, in the multipurpose building at Sawan Park, with no collection on race morning [2]. Kits could also be posted in September for THB 60 [1].

Fees were THB 1,220 for the marathon, THB 920 for the half, THB 720 for the 10 km and THB 570 for the 5 km, about THB 200 less in the May early-bird period [1]. Every finisher got a medal and every entrant a race shirt; marathon and half finishers also got a finisher shirt [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the Next Race?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want a quiet, low-cost provincial marathon with a seven-hour limit and a realistic shot at an age-group trophy, especially if you are over 40. The half marathon suits runners who can finish inside 3:15 with a little to spare.
Think twice if you want crowds, a published aid plan, or a fast course in cool air: the 2026 race ran in 27°C air with a 26°C dew point.
A 2027 date had not been announced when this was written.
Nobody from this site ran the race. This review draws on the organiser's entry page, schedule and route maps, the full results, and modelled weather data.

faqs.question: What time does the Angthong Marathon start?
faqs.answer: Early. In 2026 the marathon started at 3am from Sawan Park in Ang Thong, the half marathon at 5am, the 10 km at 5.30am and the 5 km at 6am. Race kits had to be collected the day before, as there was no collection on race morning.

faqs.question: What is the half-marathon cut-off at the Angthong Marathon?
faqs.answer: Three and a half hours, which is tighter than many Thai half marathons. In 2026 everyone who finished made it, the slowest in 3:28:36, and one in ten finishers took longer than three hours. The marathon limit is seven hours, the 10 km two hours and the 5 km one hour.

faqs.question: How big is the Angthong Marathon?
faqs.answer: Small. In 2026 about 923 runners entered against a cap of 2,000, and 767 finished: 99 in the marathon, 197 in the half marathon, 280 in the 10 km and 191 in the 5 km. Most marathoners were aged 40 to 59, and trophies go five deep in each age group.

faqs.question: What is the weather like at the Angthong Marathon?
faqs.answer: Warm and humid. Modelled weather for Ang Thong shows about 27°C and 93% humidity at the 3am start in 2026, with a 26°C dew point and full cloud. It stayed near 27°C until 7am, then reached 30°C by 9am and 32°C by the 10am marathon cut-off.

editorial_notes: Written 2026-11-06 about the edition that ran on Sunday 4 October 2026; the next edition's date was not found. Finish-time figures are Run SEA's analysis of the official ThaiMTB Chip results; entrant, non-starter and checkpoint figures are from the same results system's data. The entity record's 'field of 2,000' was the entry cap, not the turnout. Weather is Open-Meteo modelled reanalysis for the grid point at Ang Thong, not a station observation (there is no airport close to Ang Thong). The route maps are stylised illustrations; landmarks are given as drawn. No aid-station plan, news report or runner account was found. No rating.
